description: Kerala has launched the Mukulam portal to provide free artificial intelligence assisted training to higher secondary and vocational higher secondary students preparing for competitive entrance examinations, with the platform developed by Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education (KITE) under the General Education Department’s 100 day action plan. The initiative is aimed at expanding access to technology enabled exam preparation, particularly for students who cannot afford private coaching.AI Based Learning MaterialsGeneral Education Minister N Samsudheen launched the portal at Jawahar Cooperative Bhavan in Thiruvananthapuram on Wednesday. The platform provides AI based training for examinations including the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET), Joint Entrance Examination (JEE), Common University Entrance Test (CUET), Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research (IISER) entrance examination and Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY).The project has already been tested through a pilot programme in 25 selected schools. KITE has prepared digital learning materials for around 10 subjects covering science, humanities and commerce streams, which are available through its new website.The initiative is designed to give students access to additional learning support without the cost associated with private coaching. The state government said the platform would enable students in public schools to benefit from AI-based educational resources.Focus On Wider AccessSamsudheen said initiatives such as Mukulam could help strengthen the higher secondary sector and called for effective implementation of such projects in schools.The launch also coincided with a one-day workshop for vocational higher secondary education (VHSE) principals organised by KITE. The minister said the VHSE sector required timely changes and indicated that it would be restructured by integrating areas such as agriculture and industry with modern technologies, including AI.The state government also plans to constitute a new committee for the proposed VHSE restructuring. The initiative is expected to focus on emerging employment opportunities while incorporating technology into vocational education.KITE's 100 day action plan also includes an AI powered portal intended to help students prepare for competitive entrance examinations alongside their regular curriculum.
